ayahs.arabic: قُلۡ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسۡتَمَعَ نَفَرࣱ مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا سَمِعۡنَا قُرۡءَانًا عَجَبࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Qul oohiya ilayya annahu istamaAAa nafarun mina aljinni faqaloo inna samiAAna quranan AAajaban

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur'an

ayahs.arabic: يَهۡدِيٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشۡدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦۖ وَلَن نُّشۡرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Yahdee ila alrrushdi faamanna bihi walan nushrika birabbina ahadan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَٰحِبَةࣰ وَلَا وَلَدࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Waannahu taAAala jaddu rabbina ma ittakhatha sahibatan wala waladan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Waannahu kana yaqoolu safeehuna AAala Allahi shatatan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And that our foolish one has been saying about Allah an excessive transgression

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلۡإِنسُ وَٱلۡجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Waanna thananna an lan taqoola alinsu waaljinnu AAala Allahi kathiban

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allah a lie

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالࣱ مِّنَ ٱلۡإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالࣲ مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمۡ رَهَقࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Waannahu kana rijalun mina alinsi yaAAoothoona birijalin mina aljinni fazadoohum rahaqan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّهُمۡ ظَنُّواْ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمۡ أَن لَّن يَبۡعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Waannahum thannoo kama thanantum an lan yabAAatha Allahu ahadan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allah would never send anyone [as a messenger]

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّا لَمَسۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدۡنَٰهَا مُلِئَتۡ حَرَسࣰ ا شَدِيدࣰ ا وَشُهُبࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Waanna lamasna alssamaa fawajadnaha muliat harasan shadeedan washuhuban

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقۡعُدُ مِنۡهَا مَقَٰعِدَ لِلسَّمۡعِۖ فَمَن يَسۡتَمِعِ ٱلۡأٓنَ يَجِدۡ لَهُۥ شِهَابࣰ ا رَّصَدࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Waanna kunna naqAAudu minha maqaAAida lilssamAAi faman yastamiAAi alana yajid lahu shihaban rasadan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدۡرِيٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَمۡ أَرَادَ بِهِمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ رَشَدࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Waanna la nadree asharrun oreeda biman fee alardi am arada bihim rabbuhum rashadan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Waanna minna alssalihoona waminna doona thalika kunna taraiqa qidadan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعۡجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَن نُّعۡجِزَهُۥ هَرَبࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Wanna thananna an lan nuAAjiza Allaha fee alardi walan nuAAjizahu haraban

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allah upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعۡنَا ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦۖ فَمَن يُؤۡمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخۡسࣰ ا وَلَا رَهَقࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Waanna lamma samiAAna alhuda amanna bihi faman yumin birabbihi fala yakhafu bakhsan wala rahaqan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And when we heard the guidance, we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلۡمُسۡلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلۡقَٰسِطُونَۖ فَمَنۡ أَسۡلَمَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوۡاْ رَشَدࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Waanna minna almuslimoona waminna alqasitoona faman aslama faolaika taharraw rashadan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allah], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلۡقَٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُواْ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Waama alqasitoona fakanoo lijahannama hataban

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood

ayahs.arabic: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسۡتَقَٰمُواْ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسۡقَيۡنَٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Waallawi istaqamoo AAala alttareeqati laasqaynahum maan ghadaqan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And [Allah revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant provision

ayahs.arabic: لِّنَفۡتِنَهُمۡ فِيهِۚ وَمَن يُعۡرِضۡ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسۡلُكۡهُ عَذَابࣰ ا صَعَدࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Linaftinahum feehi waman yuAArid AAan thikri rabbihi yaslukhu AAathaban saAAadan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّ ٱلۡمَسَٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدۡعُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Waanna almasajida lillahi fala tadAAoo maAAa Allahi ahadan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allah, so do not invoke with Allah anyone

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبۡدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدۡعُوهُ كَادُواْ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيۡهِ لِبَدࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Waannahu lamma qama AAabdu Allahi yadAAoohu kadoo yakoonoona AAalayhi libadan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And that when the Servant of Allah stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass

ayahs.arabic: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَدۡعُواْ رَبِّي وَلَآ أُشۡرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Qul innama adAAoo rabbee wala oshriku bihi ahadan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Say, [O Muhammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone

ayahs.arabic: قُلۡ إِنِّي لَآ أَمۡلِكُ لَكُمۡ ضَرࣰّ ا وَلَا رَشَدࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Qul innee la amliku lakum darran wala rashadan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction

ayahs.arabic: قُلۡ إِنِّي لَن يُجِيرَنِي مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدࣱ وَلَنۡ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلۡتَحَدًا
ayahs.translit: Qul innee lan yujeeranee mina Allahi ahadun walan ajida min doonihi multahadan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allah anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا بَلَٰغࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَٰلَٰتِهِۦۚ وَمَن يَعۡصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا
ayahs.translit: Illa balaghan mina Allahi warisalatihi waman yaAAsi Allaha warasoolahu fainna lahu nara jahannama khalideena feeha abadan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But [I have for you] only notification from Allah, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever

ayahs.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوۡاْ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ أَضۡعَفُ نَاصِرࣰ ا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Hatta itha raaw ma yooAAadoona fasayaAAlamoona man adAAafu nasiran waaqallu AAadadan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number

ayahs.arabic: قُلۡ إِنۡ أَدۡرِيٓ أَقَرِيبࣱ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمۡ يَجۡعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّيٓ أَمَدًا
ayahs.translit: Qul in adree aqareebun ma tooAAadoona am yajAAalu lahu rabbee amadan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period

ayahs.arabic: عَٰلِمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ فَلَا يُظۡهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيۡبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
ayahs.translit: AAalimu alghaybi fala yuthhiru AAala ghaybihi ahadan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرۡتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولࣲ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسۡلُكُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ يَدَيۡهِ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِۦ رَصَدࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Illa mani irtada min rasoolin fainnahu yasluku min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi rasadan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before each messenger and behind him observers

ayahs.arabic: لِّيَعۡلَمَ أَن قَدۡ أَبۡلَغُواْ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ وَأَحۡصَىٰ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ عَدَدَۢا
ayahs.translit: LiyaAAlama an qad ablaghoo risalati rabbihim waahata bima ladayhim waahsa kulla shayin AAadadan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: That he may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number
